key.name: group-displays
key.description: One brightness and one contrast slider apply the same level to every display.

key.name: show-contrast
key.description: When disabled, only brightness sliders are shown.

key.name: slider-placement
key.description: With "tile" the sliders are in a Quick Settings tile with a menu. With "inline" the brightness sliders sit below the brightness slider of GNOME, without a tile. "inline" only has an effect on the GNOME Shell versions it was checked on.
